resources.string: Bob helps your parent use their phone, one spoken step at a time. Setup takes 2 minutes.

Bob reads the text on the screen and takes a picture of it only when Bob is pressed or while it is guiding a task. Common tasks are guided on the phone itself. Otherwise these are sent to Bob\'s server to decide the next step and are not stored, except that the step given for a screen of a shopping or settings app may be kept for a few days, with nothing that identifies your phone. Bob never taps anything itself, and it cannot see PIN or payment screens.
In Settings, open \"Downloaded apps\" or \"Installed apps\", choose Bob and turn it on.
If the switch is greyed out, open App info, tap ⋮ at the top and choose \"Allow restricted settings\".
In any app, press the yellow Bob board and say what you want to do. For example: \"I want to video call my son on WhatsApp\".
I could not hear you. Press Bob and speak again.
The internet is not working. Please try again in a little while.
First, please allow the microphone for Bob.
Careful! This app lets a stranger control your phone. If someone on a call asked you to open it, close it now and call your family.
This part you do yourself. Never tell this number to anyone, even on the phone.
You are on a call. If anyone asks for an OTP, PIN or money, cut the call now. Press Bob again after the call. To hear better, press Speaker on the call screen.
Another app is using the microphone. Close it and press Bob again.
To understand you I need the internet. Turn on mobile data or Wi-Fi, or ask your family to download offline speech.
This phone cannot listen yet. Ask your family to install or update the Google app.
Hold the phone near your mouth and speak a little louder. Press Bob and try again.
Bob is busy right now. Please try again in a minute.
You have asked many questions today. Simple tasks still work; for others, please ask again tomorrow.
Bob looks at the screen and tells you out loud what to press next. It never presses anything itself.
Hello, I am Bob. I will help you, one step at a time.
This phone has no voice for this language yet. Install it so Bob can speak.
Heard it? Then the voice is ready.
Download speech for use without internet
Downloading. Keep the phone on Wi-Fi.
Bob needs to see the screen to point at buttons. It never presses anything.
Bob listens only after you press him.
Anything else I can help with?
Okay. Press Bob whenever you need me.
I can’t read this screen. Open the app and tap Bob again.
